title: DNA review v2
description: One sample's review list (PROP-0012). Labels come from one registry (review-v2.labels.json); the policy that sorts them is printed in provenance.policy. Shapes shared with dna.notation/v1 and dna.consensus/v1 are referenced by $id.

error.description: Why the call failed; present exactly for call_failed.

calls.description: The sample's calls in the profile notation; for called under a profile that declares notation.

callable.description: The call's callable reference segments, merged, 1-based inclusive; for called.

reference_only.description: Reportable positions (1-based, increasing) the consensus decided as the reference by reference confirmations alone (ADR-0080); for called.

windows.description: The target profile's nomenclature repeat windows over the reportable regions; for called.

annotations.description: Data-detected annotations in id order; for called and call_failed.

reference.description: The reference base; null for an inserted base.

alternate.description: The called base; null for a deleted base.

explained.description: Whether the components explain the stretch at the read's own noise level (ADR-0082). Only then is each component compared with the reference; otherwise components carry offset and fraction alone.

components.description: Every component the modality asserts, the dominant sequence (offset 0) first; in an explained mixture a component placed on the reference also gives its interval, sequence, and calls.

unexplained.description: Reference positions (1-based, increasing) of the calls the components do not explain.

offset.description: Calls by which the sequence's run is longer (positive) or shorter (negative) than the dominant one's.

fraction.description: Its share of the fitted signal.

first.description: First reference position the component covers; after last when it crosses the origin.

sequence.description: Its bases over first..last on the reference strand.

calls.description: Its eligible edits in the profile notation, in reference order; empty under a profile without notation.

labelId.description: A label ID from the registry (review-v2.labels.json).

role.description: How the read bears on the label: supporting or opposing a decision, or the read the label is about (subject).

oneOf.description: The site has supporting and opposing reads, and a supporting read lies on another strand than an opposing one.
At a decided site, a supporting or uninformative read that bounds the item shows it whole, or through the end its strand reaches first, as another sequence than the decision.
A decided run at least review.run_growth bases longer than its reference run, whose length rests on an anchored end or on a single supporting read.
A decided deletion that rests on a single read within review.edge_zone positions of a reportable region's first or last position.
A decided site resting on a single read whose call is at least review.run_growth bases shorter than a reference run of at least review.phase_run bases.
The consensus site is contested (a tie) or unresolved (no clean observation), or its call holds an N.
The consensus decided another sequence than the reference, and the call step excluded it: no call lies within one position.
The site holds a run whose length is phase_loss or reference_frame, so its 3' end is not callable; runs whose length the profile leaves unrecorded are not listed.
Positions outside every site that admitted reads cover but none makes callable.
A variant site with exactly one supporting read.
Every supporting read of a variant site lies on one strand.
A run's length rests on an anchored end: the first masked call reading another base after the run marks its end (ADR-0071).
Both strands read the position cleanly, and a read on each strand shows the same second base above its threshold, not a neighbour's base. Per-read shares and thresholds are in the position's reads.
One strand alone reads the position cleanly; its call's second peak has cause second_template, exceeds the run-signal threshold of its key, and is not a neighbour's base.
The call is unmasked but neither trusted nor exempt: inside the read-end margin, untrimmed, or next to a masked call.
The call is masked but still anchors the alignment; from is the first position of the read's masked stretch that reaches the item.
The call is masked for a reason other than an anchoring phase shift; reason is the modality's mask reason, verbatim.

annotation.description: A maximal run of reference columns where the sample's reads show one characteristic of their own (one label, equal detail), detected in the data: never a fixed width, a profile window, or a whole region. Annotations may overlap; mixture.length annotations are one per read.

id.description: A1, A2, ... in order of first, then label, then the first read.

reads.description: Every read whose own signal makes the annotation, with its own bounds.

strands.description: Per strand over the annotation: affected (a read on that strand makes it), clean (a read on that strand covers it callable and unmasked), absent (no read on that strand covers it).

window.description: A nomenclature repeat window of the target profile: profile knowledge, not data.

cause.description: Why the call shows a second peak, from its signal (SRS-CALL-021): the modality's cause, refined by the run signal to `context` when one is given; absent when the share does not reach signal_processing.second_floor.

threshold.description: The share the second base had to exceed at this call (SRS-CALL-020): signal_processing.second_floor, or its key's run level with --signal.

run_calls.description: With --signal, the key's calls in the run signal, the sample's own taken out.

mask.description: The modality's mask reason when state is masked, verbatim; null otherwise.

within.description: IDs of the annotations this position lies in.

reads.description: Every admitted read covering the position, in read order.

id.description: Stable for the same sample, columns, and rules version: I- and the first 12 hex digits of SHA-256 over sample_id, first, last, and rules.

region.description: The profile region the item lies in.

kind.description: doubt when a label of policy class doubt is present; else abstain when one of class abstain is; else variant when the item holds a call or a decided non-reference sequence; else context (only context labels, for example a one-strand second base outside every site). Only doubt and abstain affect clear.

sequence.description: The decided sequence over the item: a site's call (N where undecided, empty when every position is deleted) or the reference base of a position outside every site; null when nothing was decided.

positions.description: Reference positions of the item, position-major, each with its own labels, the annotations it lies in, and every covering read's observation.

rules.description: Version of the label predicates, equal to the review plugin version.

signal.description: The run signal (dna.signal/v1) the second-channel thresholds were judged against, when one was given.

policy.description: The review plugin's policy: the class and rank of every label, and its version. A policy change bumps only this version.

labels.description: For every label ID, the number of occurrences, zeros included.

review.description: Positions a doubt or abstain item holds.

regions.description: One per profile region, in profile order.

clear.description: status is called and no doubt or abstain item lies in the region.
